name: _meta
script: return "v0.10 功能回归：灯箱键盘导航/缩放/胶片条定位/图注编辑保存 + ⌘K 快速列表与搜索跳转。前置：gen-demo 演示数据。"

name: 02-open-kyoto
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('京都')); if (!h) throw new Error('找不到京都'); h.click(); 'ok'

name: 03-open-lightbox
script: const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('main img'); if (imgs.length < 2) throw new Error('照片不足'); imgs[0].click(); 'ok'

name: 04-lightbox-open
script: if (!document.body.textContent.includes('1 / 10')) throw new Error('信息栏计数不对'); if (!document.querySelector('img[src*="gallery-media://t/"], img[src*="media"]')) {} const strip = document.querySelectorAll('.fixed img').length; if (strip < 8) throw new Error('胶片条缺失'); 'lightbox-ok'

name: 05-arrow-right
script: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowRight' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (!document.body.textContent.includes('2 / 10')) throw new Error('右键切换失败'); 'nav-ok'

name: 06-zoom-in-out
script: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '+' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const box = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-stage-box]'); const t1 = box?.getAttribute('style') ?? ''; if (!t1.includes('scale(1.3')) throw new Error('放大失败: ' + t1); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '0' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); 'zoom-ok'

name: 07-filmstrip-jump
script: const thumbs = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=lightbox-filmstrip] button')]; if (thumbs.length < 4) throw new Error('胶片条按钮不足'); thumbs[3].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (!document.body.textContent.includes('4 / 10')) throw new Error('胶片条跳转失败'); 'strip-ok'

name: 09-edit-caption
script: const cap = [...document.querySelectorAll('main [role="button"]')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('常寂光寺')); if (!cap) throw new Error('找不到图注'); cap.click(); 'ok'

name: 11-caption-save
script: const ta = document.querySelector('textarea[placeholder^="给这张照片"]'); if (!ta) throw new Error('图注输入缺失'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(ta, '常寂光寺的山门（E2E 已编辑）'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '保存'); if (!b) throw new Error('保存按钮缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 12-caption-saved
script: if (!document.body.textContent.includes('E2E 已编辑')) throw new Error('图注未更新'); 'caption-ok'

name: 14-cmdk-quicklist
script: if (!document.body.textContent.includes('全部旅行')) throw new Error('⌘K 快速列表缺失'); 'ok'

name: 15-cmdk-search
script: const inp = document.querySelector('input[placeholder^="搜索旅行标题"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(inp, '洱海'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); if (![...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.textContent.includes('大理'))) throw new Error('⌘K 未命中大理'); 'search-ok'

name: 16-cmdk-jump
script: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); if (!document.body.textContent.includes('大理')) throw new Error('跳转失败'); 'jump-ok'
